content.title: ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’: How to Watch and What to Expect
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News ‘Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special’: How to Watch and What to Expect Here's everything to know about Disney's hour-long streaming special, including how to watch it online for free. Miley Cyrus as Hannah Montana for 20th Anniversary Special. Courtesy of Disney If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission. Exactly 20 years after Hannah Montana first premiered on Disney Channel, Miley Cyrus is once again “Pumpin’ Up the Party” with a highly-anticipated hour-long streaming event. The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special, dropping on Disney+ on Tuesday, March 24, features an in-depth interview with Cyrus hosted by Call Her Daddy‘s Alex Cooper, a behind-the-scenes look at the pop star’s archival wardrobe, guest appearances, a musical performance by the three-time Grammy winner, amongst other surprises. For those not yet subscribed to Disney’s streaming service, customers can bundle and save 45 percent when opting for the Disney+, Hulu bundle, starting at $12.99 per month. For context, on its own, a Disney+ subscription starts at $11.99 per month for the ad-supported plan. Related Stories For another way to save, DirecTV’s MyEntertainment Genre Pack includes Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max and 60+ top entertainment channels and is currently offering a five-day free trial, meaning new subscribers can watch the special at no cost. Following the trial period, the package costs just $34.99 per month. At a Glance: How to Stream Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special When: Tuesday, March 24, 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET Stream online: Disney+ or Disney+ via DirecTV MyEntertainment Genre Pack (includes Disney+, Hulu and HBO Max and offers a five-day free trial) On top of the streaming event, Disney teamed with popular fashion and lifestyle brands, including Stoney Clover Lane, Adidas, Hollister and Funko, on limited-edition Hannah Montana merchandise to mark the milestone. Stoney Clover Lane x Hannah Montana Part Time Pop Star Reversible Large Everything Tote The reversible nature of this bag delivers two totes in one. Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special: Release Date, Where to Stream The hour-long special will be released on Disney+ on Tuesday, March 24, at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET. Best Disney+ Streaming Deals 2026 Deal-savvy streamers can bundle and save 45 percent when opting for the Disney+, Hulu bundle, starting at $12.99 per month. For context, on its own, a Disney+ subscription starts at $11.99 per month for the ad-supported plan, so for just one dollar more, customers can enjoy both services instead of one. Other bundle deals include Disney+, Hulu and HBO Max, starting at $19.99 per month (a savings of 42 percent), and Disney+, Hulu and all ESPN services, starting at $35.99 per month (a savings of 33 percent). For more ways to bundle and save, the DirecTV MyEntertainment Genre Pack includes Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max and 60+ top entertainment channels and is currently offering a five-day free trial, meaning new subscribers can watch the special at no cost. Following the trial period, the package costs just $34.99 per month. Learn more about the best Disney+ bundle deals here.
